locations.name: Sa Foradada
locations.description: Wood-fired paella cooked on a cliff over the sea at the tip of the Sa Foradada peninsula — reached by a ~45-minute hike down from Son Marroig (or by boat). No reservations, first come first served; go early. Manus calls it 'incredibly memorable' and slots it for the Sep 2 anchor: hike down, paella lunch, hike back up for the Son Marroig sunset. The most Ravello-hike-to-lunch thing on the whole Mallorca list.
locations.address: Diseminado Sa Foradada, 2, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Flagship item: wood-fired paella on a cliff by the sea, reached by a 45-min hike from Son Marroig. Incredibly memorable; no reservation — first come, first served. Perfect for Aug 31 or Sep 1-2.

locations.name: Son Marroig
locations.description: Archduke Ludwig Salvator's clifftop estate 10 minutes from Deià — per Manus, 'the single best sunset viewpoint on the island,' watched from the white marble temple on the cliff edge over the Sa Foradada rock arch. Free; do it one evening of the Deià stay. Also the trailhead for the Sa Foradada paella hike, so the two chain into one afternoon-to-sunset day.
locations.address: Ctra. Ma-10, km 65.5, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Flagship item: the single best sunset viewpoint on the island — free, 10-min drive from Deià, sunset from the marble temple on the cliff. Do it one evening during the Deià stay.

locations.name: Sparkling Boats
locations.description: Private boat charter operator based at Puerto Portals marina — Manus's Priority-1 pick for the Palma-leg boat day (Fri Sep 4 or Sat Sep 5). Book via WhatsApp +34 641 112 334; limited peak-season fleet and their own site warns peak dates book out early. The Palma counterpart to the Nautiq charter on the Costa Brava leg.
locations.address: Puerto Portals, 07181 Portals Nous, Calvià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: PRIORITY 1 — message today: WhatsApp +34 641 112 334 with preferred date (Sep 4 or 5). Peak season, limited fleet; 'peak season dates book out early.'

locations.name: Mas Pastora
locations.description: The booked Costa Brava base (check-in Mon Sep 7, per the Manus itinerary) — in Llafranc, which settles the leg-3 base question: seafront promenade, the Camí de Ronda stroll to Calella for slow lunches, Casamar and the cocktail bars walkable, and Nautiq's charters departing from the same town. The Sep 10 wind-down day is built around its pool.
locations.address: Carrer Clara Campoamor Rodríguez, s/n, 17211 Llafranc, Girona, Spain

references.note: The Costa Brava hotel in the day-by-day plan: 'Mon Sep 7 — fly to BCN, drive to Costa Brava, settle into Mas Pastora'; Sep 10 relaxing day at the hotel pool with a slow walk to Calella.

locations.name: Ca's Patró March
locations.description: Rustic, open-air seafood restaurant built into the cliffside above Cala Deià, right on the water — famous from The Night Manager, standout shrimp and paprika octopus, and the hardest table of the trip. Booking mechanics per Manus: reservations release ONLINE at midnight Mallorca time (6 PM ET), roughly two weeks out — for a Sep 1/2 lunch, start trying Aug 17-18 and set an alarm; slots fill in minutes. Ideal format: late lunch after swimming in the cove. If no slot lands, Ca'n Lluc sits 30 meters away on the same rocks. (The cove itself was rated C-tier — go for the restaurant, not the beach.)
locations.address: Carrer Sa Cala, 16, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: PRIORITY 1: book online at midnight Mallorca time (6 PM ET); start trying Aug 17-18 for a Tue Sep 1 / Wed Sep 2 lunch. Slots fill in minutes — set your alarm.

locations.tags: book-asap, cliffside, lunch, midnight-release, reservation-required, seafood, waterfront

locations.name: Cooking Class Soqueta
locations.description: Private, highly curated cooking experience in Palma — the 'Mamma Agata equivalent': guided Mercat de l'Olivar tour to buy ingredients, then cooking in a private kitchen. Booking is direct and personal (email/WhatsApp, small operation, limited dates) and private couples sessions book up 2-3 weeks ahead in peak season — Manus made it Priority 1: contact today for Sep 3, 4, or 5, now slotted as the Sep 3 transfer-day-into-Palma anchor.

references.note: PRIORITY 1 — contact today via email/WhatsApp for Thu Sep 3, Fri Sep 4 or Sat Sep 5. Small operation, limited dates; private couples sessions book 2-3 weeks ahead in peak season. Slotted Sep 3 in the day-by-day plan.

locations.geo_note: Geocoder resolved Soqueta's registered address out in Platja de Palma; the experience itself starts at Mercat de l'Olivar in central Palma. Confirm the meeting point when booking.

locations.name: Via Ferrata Cala del Molí
locations.description: The only sea-cliff via ferrata in Europe — 20 m above the waves, K1–K2 beginner-friendly, 2-3 hours with Nepalese rope bridges across the coves; two creators raved (explicit 10/10) and it's Chelsea's top pick, slotted for the Tue Sep 8 morning. Booking: guided small groups at ~€46-48/person including guide and all equipment, via GetYourGuide/Viator or direct (info@enfilat.com, WhatsApp +34 627 972 400 / +34 623 10 42 37); confirm 72 hours in advance. ~25 minutes from Mas Pastora in Llafranc.
locations.address: Carrer de Sicília, 17220 Sant Feliu de Guíxols, Girona, Spain

references.note: PRIORITY 2 — book this week for Tue Sep 8 or Wed Sep 9: GetYourGuide, Viator, or direct (info@enfilat.com, WhatsApp +34 627 972 400 / +34 623 10 42 37); confirm 72 hrs ahead. ~€46-48/person, 2-3 h, guide + equipment included. Chelsea's top pick.

locations.tags: adventure, anchor-activity, book-asap, climbing, guided, sea-cliffs, via-ferrata

locations.name: Purobeach Illetas
locations.description: The plush, Miami-style luxury beach club near Palma — daybeds, Balinese beds, table service on the water at Illetes. Slotted for Sat Sep 5 in the plan; book a daybed online at purobeach.com (or call) — weekend daybeds sell out, weekdays hold with a few days' notice. The Arienzo/La Fontelina-style beach-club day of the Palma leg.
locations.address: Passeig Illetes, 58B, 07181 Cas Català-Illetes, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: PRIORITY 2 — book a daybed/Balinese bed online at purobeach.com or call, for one of Sep 3-6. Daybeds sell out on weekends; weekday fine with a few days notice. Slotted Sat Sep 5.

locations.name: Private Boat Charter (Costa Brava)
locations.description: The Costa Brava boat day — operator now identified: Nautiq, departing from Llafranc (steps from Mas Pastora), €450 for 4 hours with skipper. Book via WhatsApp +34 618 786 569 about a week ahead; less competitive than the Palma charters. Slotted Wed Sep 9: north along the pine-fringed cliffs to drop anchor in coves invisible from the road, with the cove-hopping-by-car day as the fallback.

references.note: PRIORITY 3 — Nautiq: €450 for 4 hours from Llafranc, WhatsApp +34 618 786 569; confirm a week ahead. Slotted Wed Sep 9.

locations.tags: anchor-activity, boat, llafranc, llaut, private-charter, snorkeling, swimming
locations.geo_note: Pinned at Llafranc, Nautiq's departure town.

locations.name: DINS Santi Taura
locations.description: 1-Michelin-star, 11-course tasting menu devoted purely to Mallorcan heritage recipes — razorfish with fried eggs, prawns with sobrassada, handmade ceramics, chef's-table bar seats — in a luxury hotel near the cathedral. The Infatuation's 'leading the way' pick for Palma fine dining; tiny room, so reserve online 1-2 weeks out for one of the Sep 3-6 Palma nights.
locations.address: Plaça de Llorenç Villalonga, 4, 07001 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: PRIORITY 3 — Michelin star, tiny restaurant; book online 1-2 weeks ahead for one of the Palma nights.

locations.tags: chefs-table, fine-dining, mallorcan, michelin-star, palma, tasting-menu

locations.name: La Residencia, A Belmond Hotel
locations.description: Iconic Belmond property in Deià — mountain views, Mallorcan antiques, an incredible art collection, olive groves, old-school Balearic glamour; unanimously praised across sources and now BOOKED for check-in Tue Sep 1. Insider tip from Manus: the hotel runs its own guest boat out of Port de Sóller — ask the concierge at check-in; if it sails, that becomes the Deià boat day (keeping Sparkling Boats for Palma). El Olivo downstairs is booked for the Sep 2 sunset dinner; Café Miro remains the bar to linger in.
locations.address: Carrer son Canals, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Booked (check-in Sep 1). Flagship tip: La Residencia has its own boat departing Port de Sóller — ask the concierge at check-in; could be the Deià-leg boat day, saving the Sparkling Boats charter for Palma.

locations.tags: art, booked, hotel, hotel-boat, luxury, mountain-views, tramuntana

locations.name: El Olivo
locations.description: Fine-dining restaurant at Belmond La Residencia — now BOOKED for the Wed Sep 2 sunset terrace dinner, exactly the format every source agrees is the point (Manus: 'arguably the most romantic dining room on the island'). Expectations note stands from the one detailed firsthand review (2/5, €200+pp, underwhelming food): go for the terrace, the sunset, and the occasion — not the tasting menu fireworks.
locations.address: Carrer son Canals, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Booked: El Olivo dinner on Wed Sep 2 in the day-by-day plan (terrace at sunset).

locations.tags: booked, dinner, fine-dining, overpriced, sunset, tasting-menu, tramuntana

locations.name: Stagier
locations.description: Tiny, romantic Chilean-Peruvian fusion room in Santa Catalina — chimichurri-butter sourdough, lobster-filled avocado rolls; the Infatuation's 'most exciting addition in recent years.' Now BOOKED for dinner Fri Sep 4, capping the Sparkling Boats day.
locations.address: Carrer d'Espartero, 11, 07014 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Booked: Stagier dinner on Fri Sep 4 in the day-by-day plan, after the boat day.

locations.tags: booked, date-night, fusion, intimate, palma, romantic

locations.name: Nama
locations.description: Asian-Mediterranean fusion right in Deià village with a stunning outdoor terrace over the valley — 'the best Thai food' per the firsthand review, and Manus's pick for a break from Spanish food. Slotted for dinner Mon Aug 31 after the Cala Muleta day.
locations.address: Carrer Arxiduc Luís Salvador, 22, 07179 Deià, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Slotted in the day-by-day plan: dinner Mon Aug 31, after the Cala Muleta beach day.

locations.tags: dinner, fusion, terrace, thai, tramuntana, valley-views
